segments.text: An AI just sent its first message from space. Greetings, Earthlings. A fascinating collection of blue and green. That message came from an AI
model running 500 km above Earth. A littleknown Nvidia backed startup called StarCloud launched a satellite with an
H100 GPU. The same chip used in today's most powerful AI data centers. From orbit, it ran Gemma, Google's open
model. This isn't a gimmick. It's a response to a real crisis. AI data centers on Earth are draining power grids, consuming massive amounts of water and driving up electric bills.
Space changes everything. Unlimited solar energy, no water cooling. And signals travel 35% faster in vacuum than
fiber. StarCloud claims 10 times lower energy costs. And they're not alone.
Even Indian startups like Take Me to Space are entering the race. AI's future might not sit in warehouses. It might
orbit above us. What do you think about AI moving to space?
